## History

Early in life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher and accumulated her own money before marrying Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and taking a two-week wedding trip to St. John. Following a marriage strained by household neatness, grammar nagging, and a conflict over a parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), she left her husband and returned to her own house.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +3 more_

## Quotes

> "I want to get acquainted with all my new neighbors just as soon as possible. Mrs. Lynde is a lovely woman, isn’t she? So friendly."
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061)

> "Well, I did think this place seemed too tidy . . . much too tidy for James A. to be living here, unless he has greatly changed since I knew him,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P14](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0014)

> "because he happens to be married already. I am his wife. Oh, you may well look surprised. I suppose he has been masquerading as a bachelor and breaking hearts right and left. Well, well, James A.,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

> "your fun is over. I am here . . . though I wouldn’t have bothered coming if I hadn’t thought you were up to some mischief. I suppose,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Emily forms a lifelong friendship with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) starting in volume 2. After arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) following a long separation from her husband, Emily travels back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) accompanied by Mrs. Lynde, who investigates and comments on the couple's situation.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032), +5 more_

- Friend of — lifelong friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>
